qe-code-002 x4 in `lectures/likelihood_bayes.md` (56, 152) is a false positive. Line 56 is `from math import gamma` and line 152 is `r = gamma(a + b) / (gamma(a) * gamma(b))` - the gamma *function* from the standard library, used to build the beta density. It is an imported name, not a spelled-out Greek variable, and `γ` would be both a broken import and the wrong symbol. This is the fourth instance of the same defect in this series, after `beta` in `imp_sample.md`, `beta=` in `lagrangian_lqdp.md`:476 and `mu=` in `learning_approximation.md`:190.
